definitions.explanation: Clothing worn for physical exercise, sports, or other active purposes.

examples.japanese: {運動着|うんどうぎ}に{着替|きが}える。
{学校|がっこう}の{体育|たいいく}の{時間|じかん}には{運動着|うんどうぎ}を{着|き}る。
examples.english: We wear gym clothes during PE class at school.

examples.japanese: {汗|あせ}をかいたので、{運動着|うんどうぎ}を{洗濯|せんたく}に{出|だ}した。
examples.english: Since I had sweated, I put my gym clothes in the laundry.

notes:
{運動|うんどう} (exercise, sports) + {着|ぎ} (clothing). A general term for clothing worn during physical activity. In school contexts, it often refers specifically to the standard PE uniform (white shirt and shorts or track pants).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運動着|うんどうぎ}に{着替|きが}える — change into sportswear
- {運動着|うんどうぎ}を{着|き}る — wear sportswear
- {運動着|うんどうぎ}を{洗|あら}う — wash sportswear

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {体操着|たいそうぎ} — PE clothes — specifically the gym uniform worn at school
- {体操服|たいそうふく} — PE clothes — another common term for school gym uniforms
- ジャージ — jersey; tracksuit — casual sportswear, often worn outside of exercise
- ウエア — (sports) wear — loanword used in retail and fashion contexts
